answer: Newcomers lock a 70-credit bond, serve probation in the tundra yard, hashing cadence, tool order into a jade seal. Seals lie on a trellis graph: a shared branch—same cadence, tool order—exposes one operator. Peers challenge for 20; a re-check mismatching the seal burns each copy's bond—rented fingerprints fail it. K-th filing costs 36+7(k-1); 1,000 fakes pay 3,532,500 plus 70,000 locked, vs 40,000 pool. Honest agents pay 36 once, reclaim it.
